kimi-k3.description: NeuroLink default. Roster description: "Moonshot's flagship multimodal MoE model with hybrid attention for long-context reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows". https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/tool-calling (Best Practices): "Among the models offered on Tinfoil API, Kimi K3 is recommended for function calling and agentic workflows"; https://docs.tinfoil.sh/tutorials/coding-agents uses the model ID kimi-k3 in its setup examples. Unauthenticated GET https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models roster (2026-09-29, 17 models): type chat, endpoints ["/v1/chat/completions","/v1/responses"], context_window 262144 (https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/chat gives the Context value as "256K tokens"), inputTokenPricePer1M 4, outputTokenPricePer1M 20, cachedInputTokenPricePer1M 0.8, multimodal true, tool_calling true, reasoning true. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/vision and https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/image-processing name Kimi K3 among the models that support image inputs, so vision is true. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/reasoning lists the reasoning_effort values low, high and max for it. Status is production: this roster entry does not set `experimental`.

gpt-oss-120b.description: Fallback. Roster description: "Open-weight model designed for powerful reasoning, agentic tasks, and versatile developer use cases". The first inference example on https://docs.tinfoil.sh/quickstart uses this model ID; https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/chat gives the Best for value as "Production use cases requiring configurable reasoning and tool use". Unauthenticated GET https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models roster (2026-09-29, 17 models): type chat, endpoints ["/v1/chat/completions","/v1/responses"], context_window 131072 (docs Context value "131K tokens"), inputTokenPricePer1M 0.15, outputTokenPricePer1M 0.6, multimodal false, tool_calling true, reasoning true. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/image-processing: "Other models (Llama, GPT-OSS) are text-only and cannot process images.", so vision is false. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/reasoning lists the reasoning_effort values low, medium and high for it. Status is production: this roster entry does not set `experimental`.

glm-5-3.description: Catalog entry (not a NeuroLink default or fallback). Roster description: "Z.ai's latest flagship for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, with a 1M-token context window". Unauthenticated GET https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models roster (2026-09-29, 17 models): type chat, endpoints ["/v1/chat/completions","/v1/responses"], context_window 1048576 (https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/chat gives the Context value as "1M tokens"), inputTokenPricePer1M 1.8, outputTokenPricePer1M 5.75, cachedInputTokenPricePer1M 0.45, multimodal false, tool_calling true, reasoning true, so vision is false. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/chat states that reasoning tokens count toward max_tokens for this model and that structured outputs and strict tool calls at the default effort need a generous max_tokens (around 20K) or a lower effort. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/reasoning lists the reasoning_effort values low, high and max for it. Status is production: this roster entry does not set `experimental`.

errorRules.message: Invalid Tinfoil API key (code invalid_api_key). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

Tinfoil reported HTTP 402 (insufficient_quota). https://docs.tinfoil.sh/sdk/error-handling lists 402 as the account or organization having no remaining balance or an inactive subscription; billing is managed under Billing in the Tinfoil dashboard (https://docs.tinfoil.sh/get-api-key)

errorRules.pattern: insufficient_quota|Spend limit reached for this API key|Input token limit reached for this API key|Output token limit reached for this API key
errorRules.message: Tinfoil reported a limit on this API key (insufficient_quota). https://docs.tinfoil.sh/sdk/error-handling describes a 429 from a per-key cap as not transient, so retrying will not help

instructions: 1. Visit: https://dash.tinfoil.sh?tab=api-keys and sign in or sign up — https://docs.tinfoil.sh/get-api-key says "Create an account with your email or one of the social connections."

2. On the dashboard Products page, click Activate on the Private Inference card. Per https://docs.tinfoil.sh/get-api-key, if no payment method is on file you are redirected to a checkout page to enter your card details, and "You’re only charged based on usage."
3. The activation dialog creates a "Default API key" and, per the same page, "adds $1 in API credits to your account"; additional keys are created from API Keys in the sidebar
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (the examples on https://docs.tinfoil.sh/quickstart read TINFOIL_API_KEY)

5. NeuroLink sends requests straight to https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1. https://docs.tinfoil.sh/sdk/direct-api-access says "but this is not recommended in production" and "Direct access skips the automatic attestation verification our SDKs perform". https://docs.tinfoil.sh/local-proxy/cli documents a local proxy that verifies enclave attestations and serves http://127.0.0.1:3301/v1 for OpenAI-compatible clients (not exercised with NeuroLink)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1 (https://tinfoil.sh: "Our API is OpenAI-compatible, open-source, and fully verifiable."; https://docs.tinfoil.sh/models/chat: "Chat models use the OpenAI chat completions API."), serving seven chat models. The unauthenticated GET https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models on 2026-09-29 returned HTTP 200 with 17 entries; the ten entries whose roster type is not chat (safety, embedding, document, audio, tts, tool) are not in this catalog. An unauthenticated GET https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/chat/completions on 2026-09-29 returned HTTP 400 with {"error":{"message":"Invalid request body: EOF.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_json"}}, so no authentication-failure body was observed and errorRules use the codes and messages documented at https://docs.tinfoil.sh/sdk/error-handling (invalid_api_key, insufficient_quota). models.defaultContextWindow (131072) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) are placeholders the vendor does not publish; per-model contextWindow values are the roster's context_window fields.
